name: Hot Wheels
desc:
Hot Wheels: King of the Road is a fun multiplayer driving game developed by Coin Crew and Adrenaline Amusements. As the name implies, the challenge is to be the “king of the road” by reaching the end first and collecting as many coins as you can along the Hot Wheels track along the way. Drive one of six real Hot Wheels cars, choose from one of the three tracks, then go, Go, GO!

Staying true to the Hot Wheels theme, the multi-lane tracks include ramps for catching big air, loop-de-loops and plenty of obstacles that can get in the way of reaching the end first. Each race is a blast of chaotic fun, as the cabinet was designed to handle up to six players at a time! If any spot isn’t taken by a person when the game beings, then it is filled in by the computer. Use the foot pedal to activate a Nitro boost, but use it wisely to keep your advantage. Bonus coins are awarded based upon your finish spot; collect the most and walk away with the most tickets. A dual camera system will also show player faces as avatars in the game

name: Infinity Blade FX
desc:
Infinity Blade FX brings fantasy RPG action back to the arcade! Based on the popular mobile game Infinity Blade, this game features gorgeous visuals powered by EPIC’s Unreal Engine 3, all controlled using the large multi-touch screen.

Players use basic finger swipe moves to spar with a variety of challenging opponents. You can attack, parry, dodge or block against the various minions as you advance your way towards the sinister God-King and the Infinity Blade. You can also upgrade your skills, weapons and armor to make your quest more exciting and worth playing over and over again.

name: NFS Heat Takedown
desc: NFS Heat Takedown is the latest innovation in the popular racing game franchise, delivering thrills and intense action for speed enthusiasts. This racing simulator is equipped with high-definition graphics, responsive controls and an intuitive user interface. Players can choose from a variety of prestigious sports cars and compete on spectacular circuits, filled with challenges and obstacles.

name: Rabbids Hollywood
desc:
Are you a sharpshooter? Compete with buddies to stop the Rabbids invasion of Hollywood. Shoot all the crazy creatures during a four-player adventure and explore 3 different movie sets. Warning: comes with edgy humor and never-ending fun! Created in partnership with Ubisoft and features the popular Rabbids: 14M video games sold, 230 TV episodes, and more than 1B online views.

4-Player shooting game
3 Rabbidized movie settings
Never-ending fun!

name: Rampage
desc: The game where the nice guys don't get a look in. Grab your way through Chicago, punch up New York, and jump on San Francisco. Three indescribably nasty characters which bear a remarkable likeness to King Kong, Godzilla and Wolf-Man, need you to send them on a RAMPAGE in an enduring 150 days of destruction through 50 different cities!

name: Spider-man
desc: New York is in danger: Spider-Man must race through the city at breakneck speed to stop an imminent threat. The game places the hero in a frantic chase across streets, rooftops, and skyscrapers, where every obstacle dodged and every enemy neutralized earns points. The player only needs one button to jump, slide, or attack, but the pace accelerates over time, making each session more intense.

name: Tomb Raider
desc:
In the Tomb Raider Arcade game, Lara Croft moves from the gaming console to a giant 120” arcade game. Tomb Raider Arcade is an intense 4-Player game where players test their skills through 3 chapters with 5 sections each. Based on the character from the hugely success console game and movie franchise.

Team up with other players and battle against increasingly difficult waves of enemies and push your limits to the very edge!
